restoration_note: The teaching enumerates successive salvations corresponding to the Lord's five accommodations: Divine Human, operative power, accommodated revelation, illumining wisdom, and the conjugate Call/Hearing. The first half (1092–1132) follows tightly formulaic Manichaean salvation-syntax (ⲧⲙⲁϩ-X ⲛ̄ⲟ̄ⲓⲛⲛⲟⲩϩⲙⲉ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲁ-Y, ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲁⲏ ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲣⲉ…), where editor proposals plus parallel structure between the four 'salvation' stanzas allowed high-confidence restoration. From section 1133 onward the page is too badly damaged: vast multi-line lacunae with isolated words (ⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ, ⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ, ⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲁⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ) survive but no grammatical scaffold remains to constrain fills. Most gaps in 1137–1186 are honestly marked unrestorable.
